case.summary: Verdict: uncertain — the evidence is suggestive but not conclusive. The flagged activity is a single online transaction (txn 3526826, $35.66, product C, risk score 0.76, device marked New) embedded in an otherwise normal in-person spending pattern on card C07671-K2, consistent with possible card-not-present fraud from a new device (pattern 3) or the account-takeover pattern suggested by the heuristic (probability 0.74), but one anomalous online purchase amid heavy habitual in-person activity is ambiguous. Key evidence: the New-device online transaction against 1130 prior transactions across in_person and online channels, plus a history of three confirmed fraud cases on this same card (CC-4294, CC-3216, CC-1475). Recommended action: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER (or STEP_UP_AUTH) per R1 before any block, with MONITOR_CARD on C07671-K2; escalate to an analyst if the customer denies the transaction.
